description: Premium Pro cup holder with rotating mechanism and integrated coaster. Features temperature-insulated design to protect desk from hot/cold beverages.

reviews.author: Karthik Reddy
reviews.title: Premium quality cup holder!
reviews.comment: The 360° rotation is so convenient! Insulated design really works - no condensation rings on my desk. Worth the premium price!

name: Desk Hook Basic
description: Simple yet sturdy Basic desk hook that clamps to your desk edge. Ideal for hanging bags, headphones, or any accessories to keep your workspace clear and organized.

reviews.author: Nikhil Sharma
reviews.title: Simple and super useful!
reviews.comment: Finally a place to hang my headphones! Clamps on tight and the rubber pad doesn't scratch my desk. Very happy with this small but impactful purchase.

reviews.author: Swati Desai
reviews.title: Does exactly what it says
reviews.comment: I hang my bag on it daily. Sturdy enough, no wobbling. The 360° rotation is handy. Good value for such a practical accessory!

name: Desk Hook Plus
description: Premium Pro multi-hook desk organizer with three adjustable hooks and a built-in headphone stand. Features a premium aluminium body and magnetic cable clip for a truly clean workspace.

reviews.author: Vishal Nair
reviews.title: Premium desk hook — absolutely love it!
reviews.comment: The aluminium build feels incredibly premium. Three hooks handle my bag, jacket, and cables. The headphone stand is the cherry on top. Best desk accessory purchase this year!

reviews.author: Kavitha Rao
reviews.title: Clean desk finally achieved!
reviews.comment: The magnetic cable clip is genius — no more dangling cables! The headphone stand keeps my Sony WH-1000XM5 perfectly. Premium quality that looks great on any desk.

reviews.author: Dev Malhotra
reviews.title: Worth every rupee
reviews.comment: Solid aluminium construction, 3 hooks handle all my hanging needs. The adjustable clamp fits my executive desk perfectly. Minor wish: a slightly longer headphone arm.
